Claim_Text: SmolVLM-500M FP16 physical peak VRAM is 1,111.64 MB on RTX 3050.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Live CUDA profiling measured SmolVLM-500M FP16 peak allocated VRAM at 1,111.64 MB.
Residual_Limitation: Evaluated on SmolVLM-500M fallback engineering model, not 7B model.

Claim_Text: INT4 NF4 quantization reduces peak VRAM by 52.24% to 530.95 MB with 16.49 tok/s throughput.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: BitsAndBytes 4-bit NormalFloat quantization compressed VRAM footprint by 52.24% down to 530.95 MB while sustaining 16.49 tokens/second on an RTX 3050 Laptop GPU.

Claim_Text: Qwen2.5-VL-7B FP16 cannot physically execute under 6 GB memory budget.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Theoretical memory calculations (>16 GB FP16) and a 16.0 GB CUDA allocation negative control confirmed that unquantized 7B models cannot load on 6 GB consumer GPUs.
Residual_Limitation: Probed via synthetic CUDA memory allocation, not live weight downloading.

Claim_Text: Retrieval pruning reduces context pages by 60% and halves latency.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Parametric simulation anchored to physical INT4 token latency demonstrated that selecting top-2 supporting pages prunes context by 60% and reduces query latency from 7.485s to 3.750s.
Residual_Limitation: Latencies reflect context-token scaling formula, not per-query GPU forward passes.

Claim_Text: Retrieval pruning yields +8.36 percentage points Exact Match accuracy gain.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: In simulated evaluation across 1,100 query evaluations, retrieval pruning improved Exact Match by 8.36 percentage points (family-cluster bootstrap 95% CI: [+3.64%, +13.45%], Holm-adjusted p = 0.0002).
Residual_Limitation: Evaluated via calibrated simulation; subject to finite cluster degrees of freedom (K = 11 families).

Claim_Text: Spatial evidence grounding improves bounding box IoU from 0.453 to 0.799.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Simulated multi-modal grounding increased mean bounding-box localization IoU from 0.453 to 0.799 across authentic document queries.
Residual_Limitation: IoU values generated via condition-specific parametric distributions.

Claim_Text: Calibrated abstention suppresses unsupported answers from 22.91% to 1.82%.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Unconditional unsupported answer rates dropped from 22.91% to 1.82% (-21.09 pp, Holm-adjusted p < 0.0002). Among incorrect predictions, unsupported hallucinations dropped from 85.14% to 16.67%.

Claim_Text: Safe and Useful Coverage (SUC) independently verifies pipeline safety at 89.09%.
Approved_Manuscript_Wording: Historical SUC was mathematically coupled to Exact Match Accuracy; when re-evaluated under independent spatial grounding criteria (IoU >= 0.50), grounded SUC improved from 22.55% to 89.09% (+66.54 pp).
Residual_Limitation: Historical SUC had zero independent degrees of freedom; remediated SUC requires spatial verification.
